# Golden Lady

## Overview

- **Origin:** a big cave down on the shore  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The Golden Lady is distinguished by her long golden hair, which reaches all the way down to her feet. She wears a dress that glitters and glistens, resembling living gold.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Personality

The Golden Lady is known for her musicality, playing continuously on a golden harp throughout the day. The sound of her music can be heard at any time by those along the shore.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Traits

_Not yet known._

## Abilities

- plays on a golden harp all day long  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

The Golden Lady is an imaginary character created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), residing among his fictional shore friends. In a letter written to his teacher [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) described her alongside other imaginative rock friends, including [Nora](../character/nora.md) and the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailor.md). She formed part of Paul's fantastical world, though he ultimately clarified to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that her existence was just a story.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P4](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0004), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P8](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0008), +22 more_
